Daily Devotional

August 2

3 Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God. (John 3:3 KJV)

Jesus was telling Nicodemus about having to be born again to be saved. Of course this is referring to our spirits being born again, and our receiving the Spirit of Christ to live within us (Galatians 4:6). Without the newborn again spirit, it is impossible to understand the things of God (1 Corinthians 2:14). A person must be born again to enter into the kingdom of God (John 3:5). Our spirits died when Adam sinned against God, and we were then without a spirit and separated from God. The only way to again have fellowship with God is to get born again, and have the very Spirit of Jesus Himself dwell within us, making us righteous in the sight of God.

We are completely unable to save ourselves, as we cannot live a holy life on our own, because we all sin (Romans 3:23), and have a sin nature from birth. The only way to be saved is to be born again, and this is the only way that man can enter into the presence of God. Praise God for sending Jesus to do for us, what we could not do for ourselves, and allow us to again be in fellowship with Him (John 17:3). Thank you Jesus.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
